race.comment: DURBAN HARBOUR (3) was better at Ballarat when fifth at long odds and is already a winner at this track and distance. Looks well placed in this race on what he d id last time out and the sting out of the ground is a big tick. Can bounce back to winning ways. WEATHER DELAY (6) fought on strongly when third in a BM62 at Horsham and had a tightening incident near the 200m, so he brings a genuine rebound case with gear interest. WINTER NIGHTS (9) worked home into third in a BM56 at Kilmore and gets Damian Lane on third-up, although the rise in grade and return to around 1856m keep him more in the place-and-value bracket. GREGOLIMO (1) will be better for the fresh run and can run a cheek race here.
